description: Grade one claim of a list verification again, against the verified list's facts as they stand now (held facts are left out) and any facts linked to it with lists.verifications.claim-reviews.create (`fact-link`). The new grade is recorded in the claim's history with who asked and the facts it read; the run's own grade is kept. A new grade withdraws the claim's earlier status, override, reopening and record-conflict resolution. Returns the claim as it now reads, with `recheck` naming the grade it replaced. Repeating a request with the same `requestKey` grades nothing again: it returns `replayed: true` and the claim as it reads now, which later review actions may have changed, not the first response. A claim set aside as not verifiable is reopened first.

requestKey.description: A key you choose for this re-check. Sending the same key again grades nothing twice: it returns replayed true and the claim as it reads now, which later review actions may have changed.
